column1: # Hand-edited (was: generated by npm run install-app). Re-running install-app
# WILL clobber the `storage` partition below — re-add it after any regenerate.
# Firmware OTA layout: two app slots (8MB each; the app is ~4.5MB) plus a
# `storage` SPIFFS partition on the 32MB flash for persistent app data
# (localStorage / config profiles). The stock plan gave each OTA slot ~16MB
# (running 64KB past the chip end) and left NO writable filesystem — so config
# fell back to the 24KB NVS blob
column2: which fills up and loses profiles on reboot.
